subject: E-3196: TLS handshake failed on Windows
body:
Hi, I'm using MeshMail 2.8.6 on Windows 11 24H2. Starting Tuesday, the moment I connect a dialog reads 'E-3196: TLS handshake failed'.

The clock shows a wrong date since the motherboard battery died. The login page in the browser also shows a certificate warning.

What I tried so far: closing every other program. No luck.

Thanks, Sofia Rossi (Halden Logistics)
